Stupidly small portions of tasty food
Jun 2018 • Couples
We ate here after walking around the area for 30 minutes struggling to find somewhere to eat. 

The restaraunt is welcoming and clean so we had high hopes. We didn't fancy steak, their main dishes, so ordered the spaghetti bolognese and spaghetti meatballs. We were shocked by the tiny size of the portions - so small that the pasta occupied about a tennis ball size on the plate. I slowly ate my dish, rationing the portion, but finished it in under a minute.

The food taste great but the portion sizes were just ridiculous. I would serve an adult 3 dishes of their pasta to make an average portion. Although a cheap dish (60,000 VND) it was definitely not worth this price for the city.

Cute little restaurant
May 2017 • Couples
This restaurant was a pleasant surprise and not too difficult to find. For 120,000₫, it gets you a 150g steak with sauce of your choice, small salad and potato wedges as sides. 

The steak, for the price, is really quite good and I can't complain. It is unrealistic to expect prime cut steak for this price. So when you look at steak quality vs price, it really is quite good value and a decent meal. Sauces were great!

It was disappointing that the dessert item was not available on the evening that we visited. The staff was very nice and service was prompt and food served in a timely manner. 

I will be back for another meal again and certainly recommend this place for a well priced steak.
